instruction: Navigate to Thunderbird's Bills folder and open the first hyperlink from the most recent email in a new Chrome tab.

metadata.explanation: This variation uses the same evaluator as the original task. The instruction asks to navigate to the Bills folder and open the first hyperlink from the most recent email. The email in the Bills folder is from AWS and contains a link to https://www.amazon.com/. The evaluator checks that all three URLs are open in Chrome tabs: the two initially opened tabs (apple.com and scholar.google.com) plus the newly opened amazon.com tab.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_open_tabs_info getter to extract all Chrome tab URLs
Metric is_expected_tabs properly compares the list of open tab URLs with expected URLs using URL comparison logic
Expected URLs correctly include the two pre-existing tabs (apple.com, scholar.google.com) plus the newly opened amazon.com tab from the Thunderbird email
Metadata confirms the email in Bills folder contains amazon.com link, making expected values accurate
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts tab list → metric compares URLs → checks for all 3 expected tabs
Coverage is complete: the instruction requires opening a hyperlink in a new Chrome tab, and the evaluator verifies this by checking if amazon.com is among open tabs
No special state access or postconfig needed - standard Chrome CDP tab enumeration will work at runtime
The evaluator appropriately checks for exact URL list match (all 3 URLs present), which is correct given the task setup
